name: queries/views.py
summary: DRF ViewSet that orchestrates query execution, history retrieval, and feedback submission through a dedicated service layer.
purpose: Provides a RESTful API interface for authenticated users to execute queries, retrieve their query history, and submit feedback, delegating business logic to service classes and ensuring proper request/response serialization.
responsibilities: Handle authenticated HTTP requests for query operations and feedback
Deserialize incoming request payloads using QueryRequestSerializer and FeedbackSerializer
Delegate query execution and domain logic to QueryService
Retrieve and serialize query history records via QueryHistorySerializer
Persist and manage feedback through QueryFeedback model interactions
Enforce authentication using IsAuthenticated permission classes
Return structured HTTP responses with appropriate status codes
inputs: User identity and authorization context via UserService
outputs: HTTP Response objects containing serialized query results or history
QueryFeedback records created from user submissions
Standard DRF error responses and status codes
architecture_notes: Implements the Django REST Framework ViewSet pattern augmented with CreateModelMixin for selective REST behavior rather than full ModelViewSet CRUD. The design follows a 'thin controller, fat service' architecture by explicitly importing QueryService and UserService, ensuring views remain focused on HTTP transport concerns while domain logic resides in the service layer. Use of the @action decorator implies custom endpoints beyond standard REST routes, and the strict separation of request/response serializers indicates a deliberate API contract design.
improvements: Replace direct service imports with dependency injection to improve testability and reduce tight coupling
Add DRF pagination for query history endpoints to prevent large payload retrieval
Implement rate limiting or request throttling on query execution actions
Add OpenAPI schema annotations or docstrings for automatic API documentation
Separate feedback handling into a dedicated FeedbackViewSet if the domain grows
Introduce structured logging and exception mapping middleware for consistent error responses
Add caching strategy for frequently accessed query history
Enforce object-level permissions so users can only access their own query records
